references.text: The Israelites did as Joshua commanded and took twelve stones from the Jordan, one for each tribe, just as the Lord had told Joshua
Joshua set up the twelve stones they had taken from the Jordan in Gilgal as a memorial
Jacob erected a stone pillar at the place where God had spoken to him, paralleling the practice of raising stones as memorials
The command to choose twelve men, one from each tribe of Israel, to carry the stones
Moses set up twelve stone pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel at Mount Sinai
Joshua commanded that each man take a stone on his shoulder, one for each of the tribes of Israel
Elijah took twelve stones, one for each of the tribes descended from Jacob's sons, when he built the altar on Carmel
